name: The Longest Journey
author: mateusmoa
description: Game support for The Longest Journey (Steam/GOG). Installs mods to the game folder and ScummVM mods such as TLJ HD, its FMV packs and HD Characters, applies .tljpatch translations (e.g. Brazilian Portuguese) and starts the game in ScummVM when the enabled mods need it, downloading and configuring ScummVM if needed. Converts saved games from the original game (game.exe) for ScummVM, without changing the originals. The ScummVM button on the Mods page shows where ScummVM keeps your saved games and can remove the ScummVM that Vortex downloaded. Extension messages are available in 15 languages: English, Brazilian Portuguese, Czech, Dutch, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and Swedish.
